Auditor: Hi team — for the SOC 2 evidence packet we need a replayable snapshot of API access logs for the window 2025-06-10T13:00:00Z -> 2025-06-10T14:00:00Z. Please include chain-of-custody notes for the export and confirm KMS/HSM keys used to unwrap any encrypted log blobs. Also need repro steps for the billing spike tied to request IDs x-request-id: abc123..xyz.

elaine: Thanks — we can provide S3 export plus a signed manifest. Quick clarifying qns: do you need the full raw request payloads or redacted headers only? And is the auditor expecting server-side decrypted artifacts or encrypted blobs plus key unwrap logs?

Auditor: Prefer decrypted artifacts if possible (we have an NDA). If not, encrypted blobs + explicit KMS decrypt audit trail is ok. We need verifier-friendly steps to replay the request stream (curl snippets, auth headers redacted).

mike: We can produce a time-sliced export to s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/2025-06-10/13-14/. Contents will be: access-logs.json.gz, kv-cache-snapshots.tar.gz, manifest.json.sig. KMS key used for envelope encryption: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345. HSM signing device: hsm-33A (serial).

sagar: For the billing spike repro, here's a minimal reproduce command (token redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "x-request-id: abc123xyz" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":1024}'
```
Note: run against us-west-2 hosted endpoint, concurrent 20 clients to match throughput. This will exercise batching and KV cache behavior we saw.

kevin: On chain-of-custody: export job will produce a signed manifest that includes sha256 checksums and the KMS encryption context. We'll attach the HSM-signed manifest (detached signature) and the KMS GenerateDataKeyId IDs used. Example manifest fields:
```
- manifest_version: 1
- export_window: 2025-06-10T13:00:00Z/2025-06-10T14:00:00Z
- files: [access-logs.json.gz, kv-cache-snapshots.tar.gz]
- kms_key_id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345
- hsm_signer: hsm-33A
- signed_by: kevin@redwood.ai
```

elaine: I'll start preparing an evidence checklist for the auditor with links and timestamps. Target delivery ETA: 2025-06-13 18:00 UTC. If auditor needs decrypted logs earlier, we need formal approval from legal.

Auditor: That ETA works. One more ask: can you include a sampling of replayed API responses that show identical latencies to the production window? We need to validate that the exported artifacts are sufficient to reproduce the incident.

mike: We can include a small playback harness (node script) that replays the requests at the same timing pattern captured in the logs. It will require a service account token with read-only replay rights. Example snippet included in the export:
```js
// playback.js (redacted)
const logs = require('./access-logs.json');
// simulate timing, throttle to original timestamps
```
We'll mark the service account as ephemeral and document key rotation steps.

sagar: FYI support will validate the request-id mapping to billing records and provide a CSV of invoice IDs impacted. I'll attach that to the export.

elaine: Action items: mike to run export job + HSM sign (ETA 6 hours), kevin to produce manifest and checksums (ETA 6 hours), sagar to produce billing mapping (ETA 8 hours). I'll coordinate legal sign-off for decrypted artifacts (ETA 48 hours if needed).
